author: Carlos Martinez
title: iRacing Stream Clips: GT Cars, Stock Cars and Rain
description: A gallery of short iRacing clips from my streams: GT3 and GT4 packs, stock cars on a banked oval, rain laps and the Red Bull Ring.

sections.p: This post is about iRacing. iRacing is a racing simulator, not real life. Everything you see in these clips is on a computer.
These are short clips from my streams. They show GT cars, stock cars and some wet laps. Some are from the Red Bull Ring. Others are from different tracks.

list: Start lights go from red to green at the Red Bull Ring in a BMW M4 GT4 EVO.
Stock cars run in a pack on a high-banked oval, with one clip right behind a black car with a yellow bat design and the number 15.
Rain laps from a Porsche cockpit, with a red car ahead in the mist and a grey lap past a red Mission banner.
GT3 packs run close together, including a pack of red GT3 cars ahead of a Porsche cockpit.
A silver GT4 car ahead gets bigger corner after corner until the gap is nearly gone.
The replay camera shows a dark blue Porsche and a red car side by side through a corner.
Pit exits and pit lane views, including one at Le Mans and one under a BRAKE sign.

sections.p: The Red Bull Ring is in Spielberg, Austria. One lap is 4.318 km. Several clips here show its hills and its red-and-white kerbs. The rest come from other streams and other tracks. More sim racing guides are on the blog.

faqs.a: No. These clips are from iRacing, a racing simulator. Everything in them happens on a computer.

faqs.q: Which cars are in the clips?
faqs.a: There are BMW M4 GT4 EVO cars, GT3 cars seen from a Porsche cockpit, and stock cars on a high-banked oval.

faqs.q: How long is the Red Bull Ring lap?
faqs.a: One lap of the Red Bull Ring in Spielberg, Austria is 4.318 km.
